items.statement: How do fused-ring topology and substituent identity affect the low-energy electronic character of the four supplied hydrocarbon models, and what evidence explains the differences or their absence?
items.expected: An evidence-based account of how topology and substitution change or fail to change low-energy electronic character is acceptable even if it revises the source assignment. One legacy CS energy, an assumed open-shell label or unrelated oxidized-product spectrum is insufficient.
